summary.text: Wilds of Eldraine follows Kellan, a young human with fae blood, and his friend Ruby across the fairy-tale realm of Eldraine, where the Wicked Slumber cast to end the Phyrexian invasion has put the land to sleep.

Fae Lord Talion sends Kellan to defeat the three witch sisters in return for the truth about his father, and Kellan kills Agatha and wins the crown of Hylda, who reveals that Talion shared in the curse.

Meanwhile Rowan Kenrith, unknowingly without her spark, joins her aunt Eriette at Castle Ardenvale, until her twin Will and Kellan capture Eriette and end the curse, and Kellan learns that his father is the planeswalker Oko.
